_comment: Extractor Configuration (JSON). Priority: CLI > Config > Default. Each export format is enabled by setting its file path. See config.yaml for full documentation.

input._comment: file and directory are mutually exclusive

regex._comment: pattern is required unless provided via --config

export._comment: Enabled fields determine output; all exports use UTF-8

json._comment: Enabled when file is set. pretty-level: 0=compact, 1=one-level (default), 2=full

xml._comment: Enabled when file is set. root/element must be valid XML names

csv._comment: Enabled when file is set. delimiter: , | ; \t

sqlite._comment: Enabled when file is set. override-type format: col:type,col:type (e.g. count:int64,time:datetime:"2006-01-02")
